dingTalkCardApi.name: 四有青年 DingTalk Card API

value.channel: ={{ (() => { const b = $('ChatGPT DingTalk Card').item.json.body || {}; const explicit = String(b.discordChannel || '').toLowerCase(); if (['feeds','status'].includes(explicit)) return explicit; const t = String(b.notificationType || '').toLowerCase(); return ['status','alert','error','incident','monitoring','health','ci','infra','worker_status','runtime'].includes(t) ? 'status' : 'feeds'; })() }}
value.title: ={{ String($('ChatGPT DingTalk Card').item.json.body?.descriptor?.title || 'ChatGPT Notification') }}
value.metrics: ={{ (() => { const d = $('ChatGPT DingTalk Card').item.json.body?.descriptor || {}; if (Array.isArray(d.metrics)) return d.metrics; const blocks = Array.isArray(d.blocks) ? d.blocks : []; return blocks.filter(b => b?.type === 'keyValue').slice(0,8).map(b => ({ label: String(b.label || '信息'), value: String(b.value ?? '—'), inline: true })); })() }}

activeVersion.name: Add parallel Discord delivery
activeVersion.description: Routes ChatGPT notifications through the shared rich Discord Hub before DingTalk. Defaults to feeds, supports explicit status via discordChannel/notificationType, and preserves the existing DingTalk webhook response contract.
